Class GameClock

java.lang.Object
simscli.game.GameClock
public final class GameClock extends Object
Manages game time progression and conversion between real-world and game time.

Time Conversion: 1440 game minutes = 1 game day. Real-time is converted to game time at a rate of 2.4 game minutes per real second, so a full game day passes in ~10 real minutes.

Time Structure: Game time is tracked as day number (starting at 1) and minute-of-day (0-1439). Fractional minutes are accumulated to handle real-time input accurately.

Usage: Use spendMinutes(int) for action-based time advancement (discrete), or advanceByRealTime(double) for continuous real-time simulation.
